page_title: TikTok Shop Analytics: Numbers That Move Budget
og_title: TikTok Shop Analytics for Brands: Which Numbers Actually Decide Where to Put Budget
title_html: TikTok Shop Analytics for Brands: Which Numbers Decide Where the Budget Goes
description: TikTok Shop analytics for brands: the dashboard numbers that change a budget call, where third-party tools help, and when to hand the work to an agency.
dek: You do not need forty metrics. You need the few that show where GMV came from, what it cost, how much of it stuck, and where the next dollar should go.
author: Jackie He
cta_pre: Want a second read on your own numbers?
llms_summary: Which TikTok Shop analytics numbers change a brand's budget decision: GMV by source, the ads versus affiliate split in Data Compass, refunds and cancellations, and shop page conversion. Covers native Seller Center versus third-party tools, why Seller Center and Ads Manager differ, and when to bring in an agency.
